svg.text: BLUEPRINT 01: VECTOR ALGEBRA, 3D COORDINATE TOPOLOGY & ANALYTIC GEOMETRY ENGINE
Physical Quantity Taxonomy • Vector Bases & Projections • Triple Products • 3D Planes & Distance Metrics

g.text: r = x i + y j + z k
Transformation from standard basis (i, j, k) to rotated orthonormal basis (l, m, n):
l = (i + j) / sqrt(2) | m = (-i + j) / sqrt(2) | n = k
Verification: l.m = (-1+1)/2 = 0, m.n = 0, l.n = 0 => MUTUALLY ORTHOGONAL!
Vector Decomposition in New Basis (Slide 018 Drill):
Given A = 3i + 4j + 7k. Express A = A_x l + A_y m + A_z n:
INVARIANCE OF VECTOR MAGNITUDE UNDER ROTATION:
A . B = |A| |B| cos(theta) = A_x B_x + A_y B_y + A_z B_z
PROJECTION DYNAMICS: SCALAR VS VECTOR PROJECTION
Output: Directed Vector parallel to B
A x B = |A| |B| sin(theta) n_cap = det [ i j k ; A_x A_y A_z ; B_x B_y B_z ]
ANTI-COMMUTATIVE: B x A = -(A x B) | A x A = 0 | i x j = k, j x k = i, k x i = j
Right-Hand Rule: Thumb points along n_cap perpendicular to both A and B.
[A B C] = A . (B x C) = det [ A_x A_y A_z ; B_x B_y B_z ; C_x C_y C_z ]
1. Volume of Parallelepiped = | [A B C] | = | A . (B x C) |
3. Coplanarity Test: Three vectors A, B, C are COPLANAR iff [A B C] = 0
Cyclic Permutation Invariance: [A B C] = [B C A] = [C A B] = -[B A C]
A x (B x C) = (A . C) B - (A . B) C [B-A-C minus C-A-B]
(A x B) x C != A x (B x C) in general! (A x B) x C = (A . C) B - (B . C) A
GENERAL EQUATION OF PLANE IN 3D SPACE:
a x + b y + c z = d <==> N . (r - r_0) = 0
Normal Vector to Plane: N = a i + b j + c k | Unit Normal: n_cap = N / |N|
PERPENDICULAR DISTANCE OF POINT P(x_0, y_0, z_0) TO PLANE:
dist = | a x_0 + b y_0 + c z_0 - d | / sqrt( a^2 + b^2 + c^2 )
dist_origin = | d | / sqrt( a^2 + b^2 + c^2 )
Find perpendicular distance of P(2, -1, 3) from the plane 2x + y - z = 1.
Step 1: Write plane in standard form: 2x + y - z - 1 = 0
Step 2: Identify coefficients: a = 2, b = 1, c = -1, d = 1
Step 4: Evaluate denominator: sqrt( 2^2 + 1^2 + (-1)^2 ) = sqrt( 4 + 1 + 1 ) = sqrt(6)
FINAL ANSWER: dist = 1 / sqrt(6) [EXACT CHALKBOARD MATCH]
